1. (Currently Amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition, wherein the first alarm is triggered at a physiological monitor location; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition at a remote station location distinct from the physiological monitor location, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor, wherein the escalated alarm is distinct from the first alarm.

2. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer.

3. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an inaudible alarm.

4. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm.

5. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an audible alarm and the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm that is louder than the first alarm.

6. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously.

7. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the station located remotely from the physiological monitor is part of a central patient management system.

16. (Currently Amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition and to receive acknowledgement status from a remote location; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, and an escalation status indicating whether the alarm has been escalated; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data, wherein the display is configured to show the escalation status and acknowledgement status of the alarm.

17. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system, and wherein the processor is programmed to communicate with at least one remote device.

18. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm, wherein the level of escalation indicates whether the alarm has progressed from an initial state to an escalated state.

19. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm, wherein the acknowledgement information includes a timestamp and identity of the acknowledging party.

20. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices only when the alarm has not been acknowledged within a predetermined time interval.
